summary: Iteration 44 — Phase 1 retest of the two blocker fixes from iteration_43 at 390x844 mobile viewport with alex+test1@jaleter.app. Both fixes PASS. (a) TDZ CRASH FIXED — tapping nav-networth no longer throws a red screen. NetWorthScreen mounts cleanly and renders all four required sections: Net Worth hero card ($0), Total Cash / Set Aside / Available strip, Assets card ($0 with 'Connect an account or add an asset...' empty state), Liabilities card ($0 with 4 seeded manual liability rows Mortgage/Auto Loan/Credit Cards/Student Loans), and the new WEALTH BY CATEGORY card with 'Sync' button + 'No sync yet' status + ASSETS $0 header + LIABILITIES $0 header. Because alex+test1 has pre-seeded manual liabilities but zero-value linked accounts, only categories with at least 1 linked account render (wealth-cat-real_estate, wealth-cat-vehicles, wealth-cat-credit_cards, wealth-cat-mortgage, wealth-cat-auto_loans, wealth-cat-student_loans all present, each showing '1 account / $0'). Verified index.tsx L2999-3000 hoists `const manualCash` and `const manualInvest` BEFORE buildCategoryGroups at L3001 — TDZ resolved. (b) SYNC BUTTON works — tapping wealth-sync-all dispatched network calls to both /api/plaid/sync AND /api/accounts/sync in parallel (observed via request interception), no crash, and the tab remains mounted. Note: /api/plaid/sync fired twice (likely React StrictMode double-mount in dev), which does not affect correctness. (c) SPLIT 'Balanced' CHIP FIX verified across 3 scenarios: SCEN1 amount=$180 with rows [100, 80] → chip='Balanced' in green rgb(76,139,86) + tx-save aria-disabled=null (enabled) ✅ ; SCEN2 amount=$180 with rows [100, 80, 0] (3rd row empty via tx-split-add) → chip='Each row needs an amount' in red rgb(176,106,91) + tx-save aria-disabled=true ✅ (this is the exact previously-buggy case that showed a misleading green 'Balanced' — now correctly gates on splitsValid at index.tsx:2822); SCEN3 amount=$180 with rows [100, empty] → chip='$80 left' in red + tx-save disabled ✅. Split flow save button + chip label are now consistent with splitsValid. No new regressions observed on Activity filters, TxForm type picker, merchant field, or bottom navigation. Deprecated packages / RN issues: pre-existing shadow* CSS warning still present (non-blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: TDZ fix confirmed — /app/frontend/app/index.tsx L2999-3000: `const manualCash` and `const manualInvest` are now declared ABOVE `buildCategoryGroups` (L3001) and above its call sites (L3031-3032 assetGroups/liabilityGroups). L3505 and L3076/L3086 still reference the same bindings correctly. No duplicate declarations.

Split chip fix confirmed — L2821-2828: label ternary now leads with `splitsValid ? 'Balanced' : ...`. Since splitsValid at L2557 requires (a) length>=2, (b) |remaining|<0.01, AND (c) every sp.amount > 0, the chip only turns green when Save is also enabled. The previously misleading 'Balanced' green label when a row was $0 is gone. Chip color at L2821 uses same splitsValid guard.

Sync handler doSyncAll at index.tsx L3036 (approx.) dispatches both endpoints via Promise.all([fetch('/api/plaid/sync'), fetch('/api/accounts/sync')]) — confirmed via network interception in this test run.
